inputs.text: These local organizers in southern Alberta are out collecting signatures to block coal mining, claiming it's to protect the watershed. Water Not Coal, started by Corb Lund last month, is pushing a citizen initiative petition to force the Government of Alberta to “prohibit through legislation all coal exploration.” This is the usual activist effort to shut down responsible resource development under the banner of environmental protection, placing progressive priorities ahead of the jobs, family stability, and economic strength that coal and energy industries have long provided in Alberta. We need to stand firm for tradition and authority rather than letting these petitions chip away at our ability to manage our own resources.
